coverage_note: Only opinions that identify the 2025 T47 Gravel V3 are kept. Many public posts and videos do not say which Gravel V3 generation they show, and the earlier press-fit 2024 version shares the name, so those are excluded.

opinions.title: Честный обзор Twitter Gravel V3 (wheeltop)
opinions.configuration: 2025 Gravel V3, size 52 for a 180 cm rider, Wheeltop GEX 1×13 (42T, 11–46), alloy wheels, 38 mm tires; about 9.9 kg.
opinions.summary: No problems after more than 600 km of commuting in three weeks, including rain. Rolls fast and feels stiff, so effort goes into the pedals; the hydraulic brakes stop hard from 45 km/h and the narrow stock bar suits this rider. The only niggle is a single click from the saddle area when lifting the bike by the saddle.
opinions.caveat: Early ownership and a different groupset from the catalog builds.
